resources.string: Thank you to everyone building KeiHome
Every merged pull request, device investigation, and fix is permanently credited here and highlighted in the corresponding Release Notes and GitHub Release.
Deep HyperOS runtime diagnostics and key fixes for day/night icon switching and notification center artwork.
Fixed notification icons staying stale after automatic light/dark transitions

Diagnosed via real-device MiuiSystemUI decompilation that HyperOS skips super.onConfigurationChanged so ComponentCallbacks never fire, fixed automatic sunrise/sunset and scheduled dark-mode icon updates in CrossSurfaceIconCache, and contributed regression coverage and device verification.
Fixed status bar and notification center icons not updating after static light/dark swaps

Identified stale ThemeResources archive handles and AppIconsManager bitmap caches in SystemUI after static light/dark swaps, adding main-thread native cache refreshes and status-bar bitmap adoption so notifications stay in sync.
Optional static light/dark icons and batched launcher icon refresh

Contributed automatic light/dark swapping for static icon packs together with batched HyperOS Home icon refreshes, avoiding MAML selector transition frame drops for ordinary icons while lowering refresh overhead.
Bug fixes, new HyperOS app adaptations, and localization improvements are always welcome. Merged PRs are credited in detail here and mentioned in GitHub Releases.
